title: ceriops tagal
intro: Ceriops tagal, commonly known as the mangrove or bakau plant, is a type of evergreen tree that belongs to the Rhizophoraceae family and is native to tropical coastal areas of Asia and Australia. The health benefits of Ceriops tagal include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its traditional uses in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ceriops tagal include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
